problem.statement: The owner sometimes asks AI to solve JavaScript exercises too early and loses the chance to practise independent reasoning.
problem.currentWorkaround: Use freeCodeCamp exercises and optionally record mistakes in Markdown or another existing notes tool.
problem.costOfCurrentWorkaround: Low. The workaround requires no custom application or maintenance.

existingSolutions.name: freeCodeCamp
existingSolutions.fit: Already supplies JavaScript exercises and a learning sequence.

existingSolutions.name: Markdown or notes app
existingSolutions.fit: Can record the attempt, mistake and lesson with much less product and maintenance overhead.

manualTest.betterTest: Use one Markdown practice log for at least five real exercises and check whether recording and retrying is useful enough to justify software.

usageCost.observation: The custom app asks the learner to manually enter several fields and maintain a separate workflow.
usageCost.verdict: The interaction and maintenance cost is not justified by the demonstrated benefit.

decision.reason: The technical workflow passed, but the product was not practically useful enough compared with existing free and simpler alternatives.

killCriteriaTriggered: an existing free product and a simple note solve the problem adequately
the no-code workaround was not tested before implementation
daily input cost is high relative to demonstrated value
the idea remained plausible rather than evidence-backed
